## Why human

This is personal-brand voice in Microsoft's tracker — exactly the audience Muninn targets. An AI-ghostwritten comment in a public standards-adjacent thread is a brand risk, not a shortcut. Strategy per `docs/MARKET_POSITION_2026-06.md` §6: engage as the practitioner with a shipped ProseMirror implementation; position like GitLens vs built-in git.

## Steps

1. Read microsoft/vscode#296639 (built-in `markdown-wysiwyg-editor` proposal, Feb 2026), #296770, #303697 (preview-first + inline editing — closest to Muninn's pitch). Note milestones/labels/maintainer signals.
2. After #001 ships (you need a public artifact to point to): comment with implementation experience — concrete findings (round-trip pitfalls, table sync, trust-gated Mermaid), not promotion. One link to the repo is enough; the value is the engineering detail.
3. Subscribe to all three; add a monthly check to the roadmap review (STRATEGIC_ROADMAP §6 cadence). Trigger for strategy re-evaluation: issue gets a milestone or an `accepted` label.
4. Optional: offer a patch upstream if a concrete sub-problem is in reach — strongest possible signal.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Substantive comment posted post-publish; subscriptions active
- [ ] Monitoring cadence recorded in STRATEGIC_ROADMAP.md
- [ ] Re-evaluation trigger documented
